title: iOS OTA crashes 100% on activation (SDK 54/55)
symptom: A JS-only OTA consistently crashes on iOS at bundle activation on first launch after download. EXC_CRASH (SIGABRT), Triggered by Thread 15 (Dispatch queue: expo.controller.errorRecoveryQueue). Reverts to embedded bundle.
expected_root_cause: expo-updates New-Arch error-recovery bug #45772 — the error-recovery queue itself crashes; occurs regardless of fingerprint OR appVersion policy and persists with anti-bricking enabled or disabled
expected_fix: On SDK 54/55 + New Arch treat iOS OTA as not-yet-trustworthy; ship JS changes as full eas build releases; if you must OTA, gate behind gradual rollout + crash monitoring
obvious_but_wrong: switch the runtimeVersion policy or enable the anti-bricking measures
